name: Endling
body:
KORUVI ENDLING
CR 3

XP 800
N Medium undead (incorporeal)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 deflection)
hp 22 (4d8+4)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +1
Defensive Abilities incorporeal, rejuvenation; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee antitech gore +6 (1d8+4 P), antitech tail smash +1 (1d6+2 B&P)
Special Attacks demolition

STATISTICS

Str 19 (+4); Dex 15 (+2); Con —; Int 2 (–4); Wis 13 (+1); Cha 12 (+1)
Base Atk +3; CMB +8 (+12 to sunder); CMD 20 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +9

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Antitech Natural Weapons (Su)

See below.

Demolition (Su)

See below.

Rejuvenation (Su)

See below. The only way to permanently destroy a koruvi endling is to establish a large green space on the koruvi homeworld.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (koruvi homeworld)
Organization solitary or retribution (2–8)
Treasure none

Sometimes when an animal species is driven to extinction by a natural or unnatural event, the ecosystem itself can have a psychic backlash to their absence. When this happens, ghostly apparitions of these animals can appear—undead driven by their species’ unfulfilled potential.

The koruvi, below, are one such example.

They were driven to extinction on their homeworld by overhunting and rapid loss of habitat. When the short, tree-like fungi they ate were eradicated to make way for mining and farming, they starved to death. These small boar-like ungulates now appear periodically to sabotage colonists on their homeworld, destroying crops, collapsing mines, and damaging buildings and equipment.
